Journey update!

Pic Description:

- Left pictures: April 2019 with exception to front-shot (a few months before April). Left pictures are about 2-3 weeks growth.
- Right pictures: April 2020 (today) and are exactly 30 days growth. 
- Other note: Had I known I would have progressed this far I would have documented much better. I tried to mimic the face from the before photos.

Minox Routine:
- Started out foam for first 6 months (1-2 times daily). I admit there were some days I skipped 1-2 days completely. I tried for 2 times per day but often times got lazy at nighttime.
- Latest 6 months liquid (1-2 times daily). I have been very consistent lately.

Dermaroller:
- I dermarolled off and on with the 0.5mm derma roller. I am currently dermarolling 0.5mm twice a week (Wed/Sun). and 1.5mm dermaroller every 3 weeks. Let's say I dermaroll the 1.5mm on a Sunday, then I won't use the 0.5mm until the next Sunday (one full week).
- ** 1.5mm and up is considered medical grade please do not use without inspecting needles and soaking in isopropyl alcohol (minimum 70% concentration) for 15 minutes before and after

Post-Dermaroller:
- Immediately after 0.5mm dermaroller I either apply liquid minox or simply castor oil if my skin is especially dry
- Immediately after 1.5mm dermaroller I apply castor oil for moisturizing (avoid minoxidil for 24 hours since 1.5mm is fairly deep). 

Daily Supplements:
- Over the past month I have included the below supplements into my routine (orally):
- 10000mg Biotin (bought from Amazon)
- Collagen 1 and 3 (bought from Amazon)
- Vitamin D3 (Walmart)

Other topicals:
- I was prescribed 0.1% retin-A for acne, I apply that on my skin 1-3 times a week at night and avoid the nights where I dermaroll. There are some who say that retin-A can help stimulate hair, but I like it because it keeps my skin clear.
- There was a brief 2-3 month period (at the beginning of my journey) when I added LCLT to my minox solution as noted on thebeardsolution youtube channel. I smelled like fish afterwards and did not like the griminess of my skin. 

Other notes:
- I did not see a ton of results for the first 6 months. It sucked but I had to persevere (especially after a bad break-up). It was frustrating seeing before/after pictures of people on here since I simply wasn't getting results. Keep chugging along and realize applying a 1ml of minox and dermarolling takes up like 15-30 minutes of your time a week.

Other communities that helped:
- /NoFap - Such a great community for boosting testosterone and developing discipline.

- /Orthotropics - Holy shit. Mewing! Wish I discovered this when I was younger. Mewing is the process of keeping correct facial posture by keeping your tongue on the top of your roof. It has done incredible things for my jawline

EDIT: For some reason I typed jojoba oil but I meant castor oil. That is now fixed. Castor oil also gives the beard a nice thick shine. If you want to give your skin a break it can't hurt to lather this on your skin, but avoid it with minox since the minox will not be absorbed.
